newsitem.title: UK: Vodafone says international growth on track.
newsitem.headline: Vodafone says international growth on track.

text.p: The chief executive designate of Britain's biggest mobile 'phone company Vodafone Plc said on Tuesday the company remains convinced that its overseas interests will be producing 30 percent of group profits by the year 2000.

Christopher Gent, who takes up the post on January 1, was speaking after Vodafone reported a 21 percent increase in pretax profit in the first half of 1996/97 and said its overseas businesses had contributed to operating profits since August.
Confirming that the group was on track for getting 30 pct of profits from overseas by 2000, Gent told Reuters its biggest overseas growth markets were South Africa and Greece.
France, Germany and the Netherlands are also very good, he said, adding, "Those are all super markets for us with lots of growth to come."
